components.title: Button
components.notes: `variant` default/secondary/outline/ghost/link/destructive · `size` default/sm/lg/icon · `asChild` for links
components.caption: One primary (default) button per view; everything else is secondary, outline or ghost. Wrap a Link with asChild instead of nesting.

components.title: Toggle
components.notes: a pressed/unpressed button (bold, mute, favourite)

components.title: Toggle group
components.notes: `type` single (a segmented control) or multiple
components.caption: Use type="single" for a segmented control (view switchers, ranges). Selected state is neutral, not the brand colour.

components.title: Floating button
components.notes: floats OVER the scroll (a Button flows with it) · Material calls it a FAB · `icon label? variant position` · one per page
components.caption: Floats over the scroll instead of sitting in it, so the page’s one most important action stays reachable. A Button flows with the content; this does not. One per page; icon-only needs an aria-label.

components.title: Icon badge
components.notes: icon button with unread count/dot · always labelled
components.caption: Header icon button with an unread count. The label announces the count for screen readers.

components.title: Action grid
components.notes: the row of shortcuts under a page hero · 3–4 `items`, one row only, last tile is "More"
components.caption: The row of shortcuts under a hero. Keep it to one row: the last tile should be "More", not a second row.

components.title: Input
components.notes: always with a `Label` · `aria-invalid` for errors

components.title: Label
components.notes: `htmlFor` the field it names

components.title: Textarea
components.notes: multi-line text, grows with content

components.title: Checkbox
components.notes: `checked onCheckedChange` · pick any
components.caption: For picking any number of options. One-of-many is a RadioGroup; never mix the two in one group.

components.title: Radio group
components.notes: pick exactly one · `RadioGroupItem value id`

components.title: Switch
components.notes: a setting that applies at once (no Save button)

components.title: Select
components.notes: one of 5–15 options in a form; fewer → RadioGroup, more → Command

components.title: Date picker
components.notes: one date in a form · field-styled button → Calendar in a Popover · `value onChange disabled?`
components.caption: The placeholder says what the date is for (“Pick a due date”). Block days that cannot be chosen with `disabled` instead of erroring after.

components.title: Calendar
components.notes: a month grid (react-day-picker) · `mode` single/range/multiple · use DatePicker for a form field
components.caption: On its own for booking and availability views; inside a form, use DatePicker.

components.title: Slider
components.notes: a value on a range · two thumbs for a range
components.api: <Slider value onValueChange min max step aria-label />

components.title: Filter chip
components.notes: filter chips in a scrolling row · selected is the theme's Chip colour (inverted by default)
components.caption: Selected is the theme's Chip selected colour: inverted neutral by default. For one choice among a few, use SegmentedControl.

components.title: Segmented control
components.notes: 2–4 options, sliding thumb
components.caption: 2–4 mutually exclusive options. For content panes use Tabs.

components.title: Search field
components.notes: Input + search icon + clear

components.title: Quantity stepper
components.notes: − value + · `min max step`
components.api: <QuantityStepper value onChange min? max? step? aria-label />

components.title: Rating
components.notes: stars · display (half stars, `showValue`, `count`) or input with `onChange`
components.api: <Rating value onChange? showValue? count? size? aria-label? />
components.caption: Show a score with the number beside it; ask for one after something is done (an order delivered), not in the middle of a task.

components.title: Amount input
components.notes: hero money field · MAX and currency switch
components.api: <AmountInput value onChangeText symbol helper? onMax? onToggleCurrency? error? />
components.caption: The hero figure on send, trade and deposit pages. Error and helper read under it.

components.title: OTP input
components.notes: N-digit code, paste-aware
components.caption: Try 123456. Handles paste and backspace across cells.

components.title: Password input
components.notes: Input + show/hide
components.caption: Pair it with a Label like any Input.

components.title: Selectable card
components.notes: card as a radio/checkbox choice
components.api: <SelectableCard title description? icon? detail? selected onClick mode="radio|checkbox" />
components.caption: A whole card as a choice. Selection shows as a ring/check plus a tinted border, not colour alone.

components.title: Range selector
components.notes: chart range (1D·1W·1M·1Y·ALL), the active one inverts
components.caption: For the time window over a chart. Use SegmentedControl when the options switch content rather than a period.

components.title: App shell
components.notes: sidebar of 4–8 destinations on desktop, a sheet on mobile · active item follows the URL
components.caption: The frame of every logged-in web app prototype. Put it in the prototype’s layout.tsx, not in each page.

components.title: Tabs
components.notes: switch views of the same thing in place; not page navigation

components.title: Navigation menu
components.notes: a marketing site’s top nav with dropdown panels · not for app navigation (AppShell)
components.caption: For marketing pages with grouped links. Hide it behind a Sheet on small screens; it does not collapse on its own.

components.title: Breadcrumb
components.notes: where a detail page sits · the last item is the current page

components.title: Pagination
components.notes: pages of a long list or table · Previous/Next + page links · `isActive` on the current page
components.caption: Under a DataTable with more rows than fit. Say where the person is (“21–30 of 128”) next to it.

components.title: Command
components.notes: search-as-you-type list · `CommandDialog` for a ⌘K palette

components.title: Menubar
components.notes: desktop-app menus (File · Edit · View) across the top of an editor
components.caption: For tool-like apps (editors, builders). A product page wants a DropdownMenu or NavigationMenu instead.

components.title: Stepper
components.notes: `numbered` / `compact` flow progress
components.caption: Progress through a multi-step flow (onboarding, checkout). Not for paging content: that is PagerDots.

components.title: Section header
components.notes: title + action, outside the card
components.caption: Sits outside the card it introduces.

components.title: Pager dots
components.notes: page indicator · HorizontalPager renders them for you
components.caption: The dots are bound to the pager; use PagerDots alone only for a custom pager.

components.title: Horizontal pager
components.notes: CSS scroll-snap pager + dots · keyboard scrollable
components.caption: Peeking cards: an itemWidth under 100% shows the next card. Dots included.

components.title: Data table
components.notes: sortable columns + built-in empty state · `columns rows rowKey caption?`
components.caption: Every list of records in a prototype. Right-align numbers; give each column a sortValue only when sorting it helps.

components.title: Table
components.notes: the primitive under DataTable; use it directly for small static tables

components.title: Stat tile
components.notes: one KPI with a signed change · `invert` when down is good
components.caption: Two to four across the top of a dashboard. The colour says good or bad, the arrow says up or down.

components.title: Chart
components.notes: Recharts with the theme · series colours from `var(--chart-1)`…`--chart-5`
components.caption: Colour every series with a chart token through the config, never a hex.

components.title: Badge
components.notes: a status or tag · a status is an outline Badge with a coloured dot (`bg-success` …), the word in foreground text

components.title: Avatar
components.notes: image with initials fallback

components.title: Separator
components.notes: a hairline between groups · prefer spacing

components.title: Avatar group
components.notes: overlapping avatars + "+N"

components.title: List row
components.notes: ONE row · the canonical row · `last` on the final row · `select={{mode,selected}}` makes it a radio/checkbox row
components.api: <ListRow leading title subtitle? value? sublabel? trailing? chevron? onClick? href? last? />
components.caption: The canonical row. Put rows inside a ListGroup (or a Card with px-4 py-0 and `last` on the final row).

components.title: List group
components.notes: the CONTAINER around rows: title, dividers, footnote, card/plain surface · sets `last` for you
components.caption: Wraps ListRows and sets `last` on the final one. `plain` drops the card for the settings look.

components.title: Icon circle
components.notes: leading icon well, row scale (≤64px) · `shape` circle/square · `tone`
components.caption: Row scale only, 32–64px: the leading slot of a ListRow, a feature bullet.

components.title: Summary card
components.notes: label/value rows, optionally in a Card
components.caption: Confirmations, receipts, order details.

components.title: Percent change
components.notes: signed % with trend icon

components.title: Progress ring
components.notes: circular determinate progress

components.title: Status dot
components.notes: small semantic status indicator, beside its label
components.caption: Always next to text: the dot adds colour, the word carries the meaning.

components.title: Timeline
components.notes: vertical status steps joined by a line · each `done` / `current` / `upcoming` with time and note
components.api: <Timeline items={[{ title, time?, description?, state }]} tone? />
components.caption: For what already happened and what comes next (an order, a delivery, an application).

components.title: Value header
components.notes: hero figure + caption · `maskable` adds the eye toggle
components.api: <ValueHeader value label? caption? captionTone? maskable? align? />
components.caption: The hero figure at the top of a page. `maskable` adds the eye toggle for anything someone might not want visible over their shoulder.

components.title: Alert
components.notes: inline and persistent · `variant` default/destructive

components.title: Toast
components.notes: transient confirmation · `toast()` from `sonner` · the Toaster is in the root layout
components.caption: For “done” and “undo”, not for errors that need action (use Alert next to the cause).

components.title: Progress
components.notes: determinate 0–100

components.title: Skeleton
components.notes: the shape of content that is loading

components.title: Empty state
components.notes: nothing here yet, and the way out · `default` page / `compact` in a card
components.caption: Every list and table needs one. Always offer the next step as a button.

components.title: Spinner
components.notes: themed loading indicator · announced as "Loading"
components.caption: For a wait of unknown length. When the layout is known, a Skeleton reads better.

components.title: Success screen
components.notes: the one success template
components.caption: Use for EVERY success state: signup done, booking confirmed, order placed. Optional amount when a value matters.

components.title: Page header
components.notes: title, description and actions · one per page, first in the content

components.title: Prose
components.notes: long-form text (articles, docs, rendered markdown) at the theme's typeset: measure, leading, flow
components.caption: Wrap text, not layout: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code and tables. No cards or buttons inside.

components.title: Card
components.notes: a raised surface for one group · never nest cards

components.title: Accordion
components.notes: FAQs and long optional detail

components.title: Collapsible
components.notes: one show/hide region

components.title: Scroll area
components.notes: a fixed-height region that scrolls on its own

components.title: Sticky bottom bar
components.notes: action bar that sticks to the bottom of its scroll container · safe-area aware
components.caption: Put it last inside the scrolling element. Children share the width equally. Mostly a phone-width pattern.

components.title: Promo card
components.notes: tinted offer/nudge card · arrow CTA, dismiss X, generated art · one per page
components.api: <PromoCard title body? action? onDismiss? tone? seed? icon? />
components.caption: At most one per page, and dismissible whenever it is promotional rather than required. The art is generated from the seed.

components.title: Footnote
components.notes: small print / disclosure, last on the page
components.caption: Disclosures at the foot of a page. Keep it last, after the final section.

components.title: Dialog
components.notes: a short task on top of the page (an edit form)

components.title: Alert dialog
components.notes: confirm something destructive · name the action on the button
components.caption: The confirm button says what happens (“Delete project”), never “OK”.

components.title: Sheet
components.notes: a side panel: filters, a record’s details, mobile navigation · `side`

components.title: Drawer
components.notes: a bottom sheet you can drag down (vaul) · mobile-first quick actions and filters
components.caption: Phone-sized web flows: filters, a quick form, a share menu. On desktop use Dialog or Sheet.

components.title: Popover
components.notes: a small panel anchored to a control

components.title: Dropdown menu
components.notes: actions on a thing (row menu, account menu) · `variant="destructive"` items last

components.title: Tooltip
components.notes: names an icon button · never the only place information lives

components.title: Context menu
components.notes: right-click menu on a thing
components.caption: A shortcut, never the only way: every action in it must also be reachable from a visible control (a DropdownMenu).

components.title: Hover card
components.notes: a preview on hover or focus (a profile, a link)
components.caption: For sighted mouse users it previews; touch users never see it. Keep it supplementary.

components.title: Logo
components.notes: the brand from lib/brand.ts (Studio › Use system › Brand assets) · one-colour logos take the text colour · placeholder + name without one
components.caption: Your logo, in light and dark. A one-colour logo follows the text colour (text-* classes); without a logo it's a placeholder square and the name.

components.title: Image tile
components.notes: rounded image · `seed` draws generated art when there is no `src`
components.api: <ImageTile src? alt? ratio? caption? fallbackIcon? seed? />
components.caption: Rounded image with a muted placeholder while loading or when there is nothing to show.

components.title: Aspect ratio
components.notes: holds a box at a ratio (video, map, embed)

components.title: Placeholder
components.notes: deterministic abstract SVG art from a `seed` · the kit ships no raster imagery
components.caption: Stand-in imagery that never 404s. Drawn from theme colours, so it follows light/dark and re-brands. The same seed draws the same art in both kits.

components.title: Spot
components.notes: an icon at illustration scale (≥64px) · SuccessScreen uses it
components.caption: The whole illustration vocabulary: an icon at display scale. For a row’s leading slot use IconCircle; the boundary is 44px.

components.title: Hero
components.notes: one promise, one primary action · `media` for a product shot, omit for centred
components.caption: The title is the promise in the customer’s words. One primary button.

components.title: Feature grid
components.notes: 3–6 short blocks · `columns` 2/3
components.caption: Say what changes for the customer, not what the feature is called.

components.title: Pricing card
components.notes: one plan · 2–4 side by side · `highlighted` on one
components.api: <PricingCard name price period? description? features action highlighted? />

components.title: Chat message
components.notes: one turn · user = bubble on the right, assistant = plain text on the left
components.caption: Assistant turns are documents, not bubbles: long answers stay readable.

components.title: Chat composer
components.notes: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks · `busy` turns Send into Stop · `accept` turns on attachments (paperclip, drop, chips)
components.api: <ChatComposer onSend={(text, files) => …} busy? onStop? placeholder? accept? maxFiles? />
components.caption: Turn on `accept` only when the assistant can use files; say which kinds (“image/*,.pdf”). Files can be reviewed and removed before sending.

components.title: Attachment chip
components.notes: a file in a conversation: icon by type, name, size · `onRemove` while composing
components.caption: ChatComposer shows these itself; use it to show the files in a sent message. Without `onRemove` it is read-only.

components.title: Chat thread list
components.notes: past conversations, grouped by when · `threads activeId onSelect onNew?`
components.caption: Beside the conversation on desktop, in a Sheet on small screens. Title threads by their topic, not “New chat”.

components.title: Sources
components.notes: what an answer is based on · numbered chips with previews · `[n]` in text → inline citations
components.api: <CitedText text="… [1]" sources={[{ title, meta?, snippet?, href? }]} /><SourceList sources />
components.caption: Cite whenever the answer uses the person’s data or a document. Stream the answer with stripCitations, then show CitedText and SourceList once it is complete.

components.title: Follow-up suggestions
components.notes: next questions under the latest answer · picking one sends it
components.caption: Two to four, phrased as the person would ask them, only under the latest answer, and hidden while the assistant is answering.

components.title: Streaming text
components.notes: an answer arriving · all at once under reduced motion · screen readers get it once

components.title: Thinking indicator
components.notes: the model is working · say what it is doing when you can

components.title: Tool call card
components.notes: an action the assistant took · `status` running/done/error/stopped · details collapsed
components.caption: Name the action in words (“Searched orders”), not the function name. A call the person cancelled is `stopped`, not `error`.

components.title: Approval card
components.notes: consent before consequence · says what changes and whether it can be undone
components.caption: Ask before anything irreversible or costly. The title is the action as a sentence the person can say yes to.
